title: Deterministic kernel fixtures
responsibility: Builds repeatable synthetic graph requests and malformed input variants for cross-runtime comparisons.

inputs.name: kernelWorkload.nodes
inputs.description: Requested graph node count, normally a nonnegative integer; zero produces an empty changed list.

inputs.name: kernelWorkload.seed
inputs.description: Numeric random seed normalized to an unsigned 32-bit state.

inputs.name: kernelMutations.request
inputs.description: Valid impact request whose input contains graph node/edge arrays and changed ids for mutation.

inputs.name: kernelMutations.count
inputs.description: Number of malformed variants to generate by cycling the fixed mutation list.

outputs.name: kernelWorkload
outputs.description: Impact runtime request with deterministic base/head graphs, removals/additions, changed and uncertain ids and sink selection.

outputs.name: kernelMutations
outputs.description: Ordered malformed requests covering missing/wrong fields, duplicate nodes, invalid edges and unsupported operations; later cycles add a round marker.

outputs.name: kernelTexts
outputs.description: Raw JSON text fixtures covering numeric extremes, Unicode, depth, duplicate keys and malformed/non-object JSON.
